message:
This PR updates the `ruff` linter and formatter from version 0.8.0 to the latest version 0.13.2 to take advantage of improved formatting capabilities and bug fixes.

## Changes Made

- Updated `dev-requirements.txt`: `ruff==0.8.0` → `ruff==0.13.2`  
- Updated `pyproject.toml`: `required-version = ">=0.8.0"` → `required-version = ">=0.13.2"`

## What This Enables

The updated ruff version provides enhanced code formatting and linting with:

- More sophisticated handling of long lines and string formatting
- Better import sorting and organization  
- Improved enforcement of existing rules defined in `pyproject.toml`
- Enhanced support for the configured rule sets (pycodestyle, pyflakes, isort, pep8-naming, pyupgrade, flake8-copyright, etc.)
- Better handling of the RUF013 rule for implicit Optional type hints

## Next Steps

After this PR is merged, developers should:

1. Run `make install-dev-requirements` to get ruff 0.13.2
2. Run `make fmt` to apply any formatting updates from the new version
3. Review and commit any formatting changes made by the updated ruff

The existing ruff configuration in `pyproject.toml` remains unchanged and is fully compatible with the new version.
